goal: Fix independently reproduced PH12-001 and PH12-002 in recovery worker admission, durable completion/backoff and truthful progress; test, review, deploy and verify native production.
context: Baseline canonical d7ab5f1, runtime951ea1a, static0c7721d, schema161. Use DueChecked, never bypass on ledger read error, checked resolved pruning. Durable pending recovery checkpoint recorded BEFORE handler execution; completion atomically persists FailChecked-equivalent/ClearChecked-equivalent outcome and removes checkpoint. Persistence failure leaves durable checkpoint and blocks replay; later safe reconciliation writes interrupted-outcome backoff before removing checkpoint, without calling remote handler. Session item lock held through execution/reconciliation to distinguish live owner; real durable provider/operation fences still govern mutations. Checkpoint+handler+completion admission inside shared control3 budget; worst-case connection allowance conservatively6 per admitted control job with24 cap. Reaper bounded, skip in-process active items, no abandon or overlap; shared role owner still authoritative. Async ledger errors reset recovery scan readiness immediately through generation-guarded progress, cannot be hidden by concurrent successful scan; subsequent successful persisted reconciliation/scanning restores automatically. Missing/failed table refuses work. Normal remote error with persisted backoff is handled not global failure. Tests real isolated PostgreSQL for read fault with valid bypass, INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE failure, no replay until durable completion, crash/restart pending checkpoint reconciliation, session loss/owner, cancellation, concurrency, healthy peer and readiness; full suite/race/native HTTP uncertainty. Additive migration162 if needed, no gate/profile/quarantine/finite-budget/route changes. Production reversible rollout must preserve split topology and not roll back to old checkpoint-unaware code with unresolved checkpoint rows. Independent actual OpenAI API source review, no blanket arbitrary bug repair. Independent review also found equivalent lifecycle completion defect; extend shared checkpoint runner to lifecycle with separately filtered reaper and admission, latch failed active keys before health restoration, and test actual rollback launcher database gate with pending/unreadable/empty isolated DB. Follow-up review found legacy unbounded RecoverOperation deferred DB bookkeeping; bound both queries to one5second WithoutCancel context and test actual handler under locked table after original native error.
